data.body: Refactored fsck repair along the existing call graph instead of adding new policy layers: extracted active-event collection, snapshot-plan population, orphan classification, stale-only refusal rendering, dry-run rendering, pause-owned live batching, and remaining-count helpers so _repair_run stays a lifecycle facade and _repair_plan also drops under the complexity cap. Validation so far: focused fsck repair, stale-channel, pause-ownership, restore, and scan-scoping suites passed; pytest -m "not integration and not external" -x -q still stops only on the pre-existing baseline test_atomic_completion_close::test_relevant_remote_rejection_never_places_candidate_on_shared_head.
